manifest.scope: Two QC source/header files before IRR-01/02 repair. No databases/config/runtime restored; reservations require reconciliation before running older writers.

pre_change_backup.scope: Only two QC source/header files. Existing QC16, QC20 and earlier calibration reference evidence remains separate. Does not restore databases/configuration or authorize an older unguarded writer.

interface_contract.ready: Existing signal means local SQL initialization, retained for standalone ready->bind connection compatibility. It is not a complete project-reference-ready assertion.
interface_contract.catalogBound: Emitted only after all local associations/snapshots/history and own UUID/path/holds are reconciled.
interface_contract.load_and_writes: Saved associations/history or a failed bind keep business load/writes closed until a successful bind. Fresh local controls/batches without cross-module references can retain original isolated storage behavior before first bind.
interface_contract.new_signal: referenceCheckpoint(QString phase,qint64 controlId): diagnostic observation at after-detach-commit/after-failed-write. No observer causes no wait; tests attach a direct connection with QSemaphore to reproduce legal interleavings deterministically.
interface_contract.dependencies: No new source/library or toolkit dependency. Existing header/moc must be rebuilt. No GUI/page/shell/original-test source changes.
interface_contract.roles: No QC role/session restriction added: independent workers save/link without any injected account session, preserving original Guest/local-page contract.

data_and_recovery_contract.identity: Persistent dataset_uuid + stable control_id/project_id; history strings must resolve to an existing control, its association, and a batch of that same control.
data_and_recovery_contract.startup: Includes inactive controls/projects and all history. Local FK violations, missing/mismatched association/rules/snapshots, missing/renamed project/result identities and unresolved history fail closed. Missing matching holds can be restored. Own-dataset orphan/conflicting holds are preserved and block catalogBound for explicit reconciliation.
data_and_recovery_contract.snapshot: Historical unit, ratio, decimals and rule-result names remain stored unchanged; startup checks structure/type identity but never replaces them with current project presentation.
data_and_recovery_contract.lock_order: Local BEGIN IMMEDIATE before catalog BEGIN IMMEDIATE for both reservation and startup reconciliation. Two-file commits remain separate; this is not a cross-file FK or one atomic transaction.
data_and_recovery_contract.safe_cleanup: After committed detach or any failed write, including automatic SQLite ROLLBACK, reacquire a fresh local writer lock, verify history consistency and real association absence, then release only supplied own-dataset keys while holding that local lock. If another writer reattached the same pair, its hold is retained. No assumption that a failed transaction still owns a lock.
data_and_recovery_contract.conservative_failure: If cleanup/recheck cannot complete, retain the hold and emit a warning. A successful local deletion is still reported as local success; the already-integrated page retains its separate reference warning. Reopen diagnoses orphan holds, no automatic orphan deletion.
data_and_recovery_contract.physical_dataset_binding: Existing catalog_metadata holds quality_control_dataset_path:<UUID> -> canonical quality_control.db path. First full successful reconciliation registers a previously unbound dataset. Same canonical file may have multiple workers; a different physical path with the same UUID is rejected without changing UUID/holds.
data_and_recovery_contract.portability_and_maintenance: The canonical path is platform/location specific. Restoring the original path preserves the binding. A deliberate relocation/Windows<->WSL path move requires both instances stopped, explicit validation of local identities/snapshots/history and catalog holds, then one maintenance update of that exact dataset path entry before full rebind. No automatic relocation or migration UI/tool is delivered. Do not delete metadata or regenerate UUID to bypass clone protection.
data_and_recovery_contract.unknown_old_dataset_limit: For pre-binding databases, the first successful full identity/history/hold reconciliation establishes the authorized path; source alone cannot identify which of previously indistinguishable external copies was the intended original.
